vacancy.title: Electromechanical Engineer for the Test Facility
vacancy.assessment: Outstanding direct ESTEC Test Facilities & Laboratories fit: MGSE design, CAD/drawings, structural analyses, laboratory/test infrastructure, calibration and environmental tests. Master's degree and 4+ years relevant engineering experience required; approximately five full-time-equivalent years from part-time industrial work may satisfy threshold, though client will assess relevance. Strong match to machine design, NIKHEF UHV facility and TU Delft mechanical/thermal work. Contractor role; compensation not disclosed.
